description: The Classic tower-one with its star set to one (the towerone fixture with star edited to 1) asks for a rating: the population clears the three-star bar but its one Security office is short of the two the Help file asks for, so the gate holds it at two stars, a pass of one rung. A second office is built and the tower runs three days; the hourly evaluation passes to three stars the moment it opens, and the scripted evaluations after it, with the population short of the four-star bar, change nothing.
